title: padus maximowiczii
intro: Padus maximowiczii, commonly known as the Amur hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. The health benefits of Padus maximowiczii include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective effects, which may help to prevent or manage conditions such as atherosclerosis and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of Padus maximowiczii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
